verdict.line: You lose if you feed E into a ready Riposte; you win if you land E raw or pop R after a landed E.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) has an 8-second base cooldown at rank 1 that scales down to 6s at rank 5, and it eats your E (Test of Spirit) on contact, denying the vessel proc that is your entire damage and sustain engine. The 46.9% win rate over 493 games reflects that Fiora dictates when trades happen; your job is to bait Riposte empty before you commit E, not to out-duel her on cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and she's near you
theirWindow.what: She can parry your E on demand, so any E you throw here whiffs the vessel proc and she gets a free AD buff plus reflect damage if you auto into it.

yourWindow.when: Riposte on cooldown or just baited
yourWindow.what: This is your only real damage window. Land E (Test of Spirit) immediately to force the vessel, then follow with Q (Tentacle Smash) and W (Harsh Lesson) to stack tentacle hits before she can reset.

powerCurve.note: Q dash lets her poke free with no punish
Riposte cooldown 9-8s, wall vs your E
R punishes any landed E hard
Trades swing on whoever baits W

start.why: 48.1% win rate over 339 games and the lifesteal offsets the poke you eat while waiting for Riposte to whiff.

boots.why: 77.9% pick rate; the flat physical damage reduction blunts her stacked Lunge and auto-attack trades since she deals no magic damage to punish.

core.why: First item in the most-played path (62.8% win over 43 games) — the armor shred lets your tentacles and autos punch through her stacking Riposte-buffed AD.
Adds the slow proc off Q/W so you can actually stick to her after she resets distance with Burst of Speed.
The health and tenacity keep you alive through her all-in windows once Blade Waltz is up at level 6.

situational.when: she rushes lifesteal or crit to out-heal your tentacle damage
her sustain from Duelist stacks is snowballing trades against you
you need to survive her burst combo post-6 to get vessel value off

runes.keystoneWhy: 48.9% win rate over 493 games skews toward the tankier Resolve page since Conqueror needs sustained trades Fiora's W denies; Grasp rewards the poke-and-reset pattern this lane forces on you.

summoners.why: 47.5% win rate, the highest of the three combos — Exhaust directly cuts her Blade Waltz burst and Burst of Speed kiting so you can actually close for your vessel damage.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before committing E
playing.detail: Throw an auto or step into range to see if she pre-emptively pops W. Only fire Test of Spirit once Riposte's window has been used or is confirmed down.

playing.title: Never auto into an active Riposte
playing.detail: If she just activated W, disengage completely for those seconds — an auto here gives her free AD stacking and reflected damage for nothing.

playing.title: Use Q to farm, not to fish
playing.detail: Tentacle Smash on cooldown (10s down to 6s at max rank) is your safe wave clear; it doesn't require landing on her to be worth casting.

playing.title: Save R for a landed E
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit and hits hardest as a follow-up once she's already committed past Riposte on a successful E.

playing.title: Respect the double-dash
playing.detail: Her Q can be cast twice within a couple seconds at no mana cost — don't consider her out of range after the first dash.

playing.title: Track her E for kill windows
playing.detail: Burst of Speed refreshes on a kill and boosts her attack speed and move speed; if it's down, she has far less ability to disengage your W leap.

playing.title: Play for level 6 spikes
playing.detail: Before Leap of Faith, avoid extended trades entirely — you have no punish for a blocked E and she out-trades you on pure autos.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Fiora has the upper hand as her (W) can block Illaoi’s main dealing ability [E]. Use your [Q] to harass or farm lane, but always keep your distance and do not allow Fiora to close in. Try not to engage Fiora if possible. However, harass her if with [R] if [E] lands successfully after reaching level 6. Illaoi will not have many opportunities to harass Fiora as [E] will be blocked, so try to make the most out of it when it lands.
